tasks.title: Make the 29 failing test files pass on the developer's PC
tasks.description: Baseline EV-0006: `pnpm test` fails locally with 54 tests in 29 files (mostly 30 s timeouts in browser-heavy suites, knock-on 409s from a run slot still held, 'fetch failed'), while CI passes on the same commit. Resolve each failure with the repository in its current folder (inside OneDrive; do not move it). Reproduce each file alone first, record the root cause per file, then fix: isolation between tests (ports, run slot, temp folders), waits that depend on machine speed, and per-suite timeouts only where a browser step is legitimately slow (with the reason in a comment). If a failure turns out to be a product bug in source code, report it as a blocker with evidence instead of changing source. Re-plan 2026-10-31 (after the first partial report): keep the changes already made; re-run every edited file alone; give auth-crawl-run's signed-in run a budget of about 25 minutes (developer decision, no cap on test points); move the clashing fixed ports in spider-concurrency/spider-signin-walls (3538) and spider-form-facts/access-token (3562) apart; split the suite into two vitest workspace projects, `unit` (no browser, no runner) and `browser` (suites that launch Chromium or a runner), so `pnpm test` still runs both and each half fits a 60-minute check. The spider-links-and-traps maxDuration test is fixed in the product by BE-003, not here.
acceptance_criteria: REQ-046 AC-1: with the repository in its current folder, every test in the 29 files passes and `pnpm test` passes
REQ-046 AC-2: no test is deleted or skipped and no assertion is weakened; every raised timeout carries a comment with its reason
REQ-046 AC-3: the sharded CI test command still passes
The report records the root cause of each failing file; product bugs are reported as blockers, not patched in tests
No two test files use the same fixed port

acceptance_criteria: REQ-001 AC-1..AC-3 over HTTP: a reachable public URL starts an audit (202); unreachable or non-URL input is refused with a message and no crawl starts
REQ-028 AC-1..AC-3 over HTTP: audits list with versions, each version opens, re-run creates a new version with the same URL and limits
REQ-020 AC-1..AC-3: edits are stored and returned with the originals

tasks.title: Helper accounts with Google sign-in (ADR 0037)
tasks.description: packages/core/src/audit/access/ and routes in packages/runner/src/routes/audit/access.ts: verify Firebase ID tokens (RS256 against Google's published certificates, cached; aud = FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID, iss, exp) with node:crypto, no new dependency; a helper session cookie; per-audit grants (view, edit, export) managed by the owner holding the access key. A gate in server.ts applies grants to /api/audits/* and refuses helpers on AI settings, key settings, delete and helper management. Enabled only when FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID is set. ADR 0037 supersedes the no-accounts parts of ADRs 0012 and 0032 for helpers.
